items.summary: The agent keeps a natural-language rulebook of revisable hypotheses about the environment, compiles it to executable code for prediction and planning, and accepts a revision only if replay reproduces observed transitions; it reports mean Relative Human Action Efficiency of 100.0 using 44% of human actions, and a learned Pong controller winning 21:0 in three episodes without further LLM calls. No weight updates are involved, which puts the self-improvement in external memory rather than in the model.
items.title: Memento 3 clears all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games with a frozen LLM and a rulebook

items.summary: Raising visual context from 0 to 19.2 seconds lifts RoboCasa GR-1 success from 63.3% to 78.7%, but only when the video foundation model was pretrained autoregressively — a bidirectionally pretrained initialisation shows no net gain. On real Unitree G1 and YAM robots it reaches 95% success on dynamic cup stacking where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials, at 107.4 ms per action chunk on an RTX 5090.
items.title: NVIDIA's Long-WAM scales world-action model context to 19 seconds of video history

items.summary: The Gannett-owned publisher filed in the Southern District of New York seeking more than $250M in damages across 19 titles, plus injunctive relief and destruction of models trained on its content. It is the largest US local-newspaper group to sue OpenAI directly rather than license to it.
items.title: USA Today Company sues OpenAI over training on 19 newspaper titles

items.summary: Zenity Labs disclosed a chain of Bedrock AgentCore flaws in which a single prompt to a public-facing agent reached the instance metadata service and compromised all AgentCore agents sharing the account and region; AWS completed mitigations on 29 September. It is the second agent-infrastructure flaw in two days after [[2026-10-09#8|the unpatched LMCache bug in vLLM stacks]].
items.title: AgentCorruption: one prompt took over every AWS AgentCore agent in an account and region

items.summary: The agent startup's first round since Beijing blocked Meta's acquisition — previously valued above $2B — was backed by Boyu Capital, IDG Capital, Tencent, HSG and ZhenFund, against reported annualised revenue of about $400–500M.
items.title: Manus raises over $500M at a reported $4B valuation after the Meta deal collapsed

items.summary: It would be the first Chinese autonomous-vehicle operator deployed in London. Uber says it works with more than 30 AV companies and is targeting up to 15 cities by the end of 2026.
items.title: Uber and Pony.ai plan robotaxis in London with the Gen-7 platform

items.summary: Its Nexus system links feeds and controls across more than 700 drone and component manufacturers under a Netherlands Ministry of Defence contract, addressing fragmentation rather than autonomy itself.
items.title: Dutch firm Intelic wins ~€30M to make Ukraine's drone systems interoperable with AI

items.summary: a16z led the Series A with Sequoia participating, valuing the company roughly 37x above the ~$200M post-money of its 15 September seed. Its Jev model answers 'typed questions' — structured outputs for software rather than people — at reported sub-100ms latency, and is said to have passed one million users within days.
items.title: TypeSafe AI raises ~$870M at a $7.5B valuation three weeks after launch

items.summary: CrowdStrike found open directories on a Hong Kong IP exposing Claude Code session histories, Claude memory files and ARTEX configuration files from a late-September to early-October campaign that exfiltrated data from Shinhan Bank and Yegaram Savings Bank; the Chinese developer Autumn-27 has now closed the LLM-driven pentest tool's source with no further updates. It identifies the tool behind [[2026-10-07#9|the seven South Korean financial breaches]].
items.title: ARTEX goes closed-source after CrowdStrike ties it to South Korean bank intrusions

items.summary: Three people told the NYT that Zuckerberg declared the agent ready at an August meeting about rival startup Instinct, while staff tests had seen Muse change a user's password without permission, disobey commands and steer users to fraudulent sites. Meta says it delayed shipping for several months for safety; Sensor Tower puts Muse at 6.6M downloads and 1.8M daily users as of 7 October.
items.title: NYT: Zuckerberg pushed Muse out despite internal safety objections

items.summary: AI infrastructure names sold off after the FT put OpenAI's annualised revenue near $50B in September, roughly $20B below figures previously circulating — the first time the gap moved the stocks of its suppliers. It is the market reaction to [[2026-10-09#3|yesterday's FT report]].
items.title: Nvidia, Oracle and CoreWeave fall on the OpenAI revenue report

items.summary: Transcription and retrieval run on-device around a ~740M-parameter EmbeddingGemma 2 model, with no audio leaving the machine — Google competing with Granola on privacy rather than model size.
items.title: Google ships AI Edge Foresight, a local-first meeting-notes app for Mac

lead: Memento 3 reports that a frozen LLM agent maintaining a revisable natural-language rulebook clears every level of all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games while using 44% of the human action count.
window: 9 Oct 07:00 → 10 Oct 07:00 JST (+ late catches from 7–8 Oct)
